title: Investigating the Capabilities and Limitations of Machine Learning for Identifying Bias in English Language Data with Information and Heritage Professionals
findings: The paper's primary findings are on gender bias, not religious bias. It was noted that 'religion' is a topic within the dataset and workshop participants reported encountering bias related to 'faith' in the archival collections they manage.
